description: Defines a data structure named CoverageRecord to represent code coverage information for a file, including covered and uncovered lines, with a method to convert the record to a dictionary.

classes.name: CoverageRecord
classes.description: A NamedTuple class representing coverage information for a file, including filepath, covered lines, and optionally uncovered lines, with a method to serialize to a dictionary.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] to_dict(self)
methods.description: Serializes the CoverageRecord instance into a dictionary with keys 'filepath', 'covered_lines', and 'uncovered_lines'.
